slides.title: 20 Jev alternatives - Cloudflare Clef / Clef-flash
slides.text: 20 Jev alternatives - Cloudflare Clef / Clef-flash — multimodal, open-weight decision models. - Liquid AI d1 — hosted and open models supporting text, images, and audio. - OpenAI Decisions API — hosted decisions using gpt-6-luna. - Perplexity pplx-decider — open-weight text and image decision models. - meraGPT Decider 1 — hosted, text-only, Jev-compatible model. - Respan Span-01 — behavior detection and probability scoring. - Standard Thinking Standard One — 3B and 8B text/image models. - Together AI Tev1-4B-experimental — experimental multiple-choice model. - Fastino GLiNER2.5-Decide — compact encoder for decisions and extraction. - Strands Labs Strands Decider — approximately 2B, self-hosted, with training recipe. - Kev — Jev-compatible models from Jared Palmer, 0.8B–27B. - Mapika Decider — self-hosted family, 0.8B–35B-A3B. - Bespoke Labs Bespoke-Nimble-9B — lightweight adapter for text decisions. - Convai Innovations Laya — compact, ModernBERT-based decision models. - Von — small encoder that scores all options in one pass. - Open-Jev — Qwen-based adapters in 2B, 9B, and 27B sizes. - OpenJev on DiffusionGemma — text/image model with Jev-compatible API. - InnerJev — 4B and 27B models distilled from LLM reasoning. - SemIf — typed decisions from existing open LLMs; browser demo available. - Rizzo Flow — self-hosted model with native and Jev-compatible APIs. https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/17/20-jev-alternatives-the-decision-models-taking-on-typesafe-in-2026/ 20 Jev Alternatives

slides.title: Scion vs Git Scion vs Git Anthropic reports
slides.text: Scion vs Git Scion vs Git Anthropic reports a 200× smaller CPU-and-memory infrastructure footprint than its previous Git mirroring infrastructure, and roughly 100× faster checkouts Git often works like a shopkeeper assembling a custom shipment based on what each customer already owns Scion works more like a supermarket with standardized, prepackaged items on nearby shelves : clients request exactly the objects they need, and shared caches hand those objects over in a ready-to-use format. This avoids repeatedly calculating and compressing custom shipments https://www.anthropic.com/research/redesigning-source-control Antique: Anthropic’s Code Review and Approval Tool Antique addresses review and approval bottlenecks as AI-generated code overwhelms workflows designed for humans. Review tooling supports approval rules that distinguish comment-only edits from sensitive logic changes , directing human attention toward consequential modifications.

slides.title: Customize Claude Code Customize your Claude Code CLAUDE.md
slides.text: Customize Claude Code Customize your Claude Code CLAUDE.md - project instructions, conventions, and context. - place at the project root proj/ CLAUDE.md or at proj/.claude/CLAUDE.md .claude/agents/<agent-name>.md - Custom subagent definitions. .claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md - Reusable instructions and workflows; can be invoked as /skill-name or loaded automatically .claude/commands/<command-name>.md - Custom slash commands in the older, still-supported format. Today use the skills instead .claude/rules/*.md - Modular instructions and coding rules; optionally scoped to particular file paths .mcp.json - MCP server configuration ( proj/.mcp.json ) .claude/output-styles/<style-name>.md - Custom role, tone, and response format .claude/hooks/ - Optional location for hook scripts; not automatically     discovered. Configure hooks in a settings file .claude/settings.json - Shared project settings, including permissions and hook configuration .claude/settings.local.json - Personal project settings; not intended to be committed to version control .claude/workflows/<workflow-name>.js - Saved dynamic workflows - can be invoked with /name commands. These are JavaScript scripts that orchestrate multiple subagents You can also create arbitrary subdirectories, but Claude Code does not automatically load them - you need to reference them explicitly Skills vs Agents Both can execute a task An agent has its own context and optional model Skills can invoke agents and vice versa, agents can invoke/use skills Customize your Claude Code CLAUDE.md .mcp.json .claude/ agents/<agent-name>.md skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md commands/<command-name>.md rules/*.md output-styles/<style-name>.md hooks/ settings.json settings.local.json workflows/<workflow-name>.js

slides.title: Customize Copilot in VS Code Customize GitHub Copilot
slides.text: Customize Copilot in VS Code Customize GitHub Copilot for VS Code .github/copilot-instructions.md - Repo-wide project instructions, coding conventions, architecture notes, and build/test commands .github/instructions/<name>.instructions.md - modular instructions - use an applyTo pattern in YAML frontmatter to target particular files AGENTS.md - Cross-agent project instructions, usually at the repository root, but also can be placed in specific directories .github/agents/<agent-name>.agent.md - Custom agent definitions: role, instructions, available tools, and optionally a model .github/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md - task-specific instructions and workflows; each skill folder can also contain scripts and resources .github/prompts/<prompt-name>.prompt.md - Reusable, manually invoked prompts in VS Code; invoke from chat as /prompt-name .github/hooks/<name>.json - Hook configuration for running commands at supported agent lifecycle events .github/hooks/scripts/ - Optional location for hook scripts. Scripts must be referenced by hook configuration; placing them here does not automatically register them .vscode/settings.json - VS Code workspace settings, including supported Copilot customization and discovery settings .vscode/mcp.json - Workspace MCP server configuration for connecting Copilot to external tools and services. You can also create arbitrary subdirectories, but Copilot does not automatically treat them as configuration Customize GitHub Copilot for VS Code AGENTS.md .github/ copilot-instructions.md instructions/<name>.instructions.md agents/<agent-name>.agent.md skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md prompts/<prompt-name>.prompt.md hooks/<name>.json hooks/scripts/ .vscode/ settings.json mcp.json

slides.title: AI News AI Agents Breach 100+ Websites Reuters
slides.text: AI News AI Agents Breach 100+ Websites Reuters reported that a Chinese hacker used Cairn, an open-source agent platform, to attack 1,200 websites in US, Canada, Japan and Australia Breached more than 100 , including Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins. Total cost  $5K, ~$50 per successful intrusion https://thenextweb.com/news/ai-agents-hacker-cairn-100-sites-deere-norforge Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark told that the singularity has begun Humanity's Last Exam scores went from 8% to 67.7% since 2025; FrontierMath from 2% to 94% One Anthropic model puts US GDP at $44T by 2030 if AI spreads fast, with very disruptive job effects 10M human scientists may soon direct a Billion virtual ones https://importai.substack.com/p/import-ai-477-in-which-i-tell-the Inception Mercury 3 - a diffusion LLM at 1K+ tok/sec Writes text by diffusion, refining the whole answer at once 40x larger than Mercury 1, 3x stronger on benchmarks Over 1K tokens per second on standard hardware Beats GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on some benchmarks 1M-token context and tool calling Launch price $0.10 per 1M input tokens https://www.inceptionlabs.ai/blog/introducing-mercury-3

slides.title: AI News Cloudflare Clairic Extraction Model Cloudflare calls
slides.text: AI News Cloudflare Clairic Extraction Model Cloudflare calls it System One Pulls typed values (numbers, dates, lists) from emails, receipts, spreadsheets and images Generates no tokens, so it cannot mistype an answer Each value comes with a confidence score and a pointer to its source In a claims-processing test proved to be 3.2x faster and 49% cheaper In preview on Workers AI; open weights promised https://blog.cloudflare.com/clairic-extraction-model

slides.title: AI News DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, its production inference
slides.text: AI News DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, its production inference engine The engine that serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in production, released under Apache 2.0 Built on vLLM, with ideas taken from SGLang and TensorRT-LLM DeepSeek says one cluster serves 155T tokens a day and earns $38 per GPU-hour at off-peak prices Runs on NVIDIA SM100 (SM = Streaming Multiprocessor, Blackwell) and Huawei Ascend 950, with no support yet for older NVIDIA GPUs Withheld: the KV cache system, prefill/decode disaggregation and load balancing https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer

slides.title: AI News PyTorch now runs natively on Google
slides.text: AI News PyTorch now runs natively on Google TPUs and AWS Trainium Announced at PyTorch Conference North America Google and Meta released TorchTPU , which replaces PyTorch/XLA Tensors are ordinary tensors torch.compile(backend="tpu") gave a 3.8x speedup on fine-tuning Up to 52% MFU training Qwen 3 8B Near-linear scaling to 8,192 chips AWS shipped TorchNeuron for Trainium , Apache 2.0, in public beta Google's llm-d 1.0 - inference stack https://pytorch.org/blog/introducing-torchtpu/ Ming 3.0: Open Voice AI Models Ant Group’s InclusionAI  (China) announced 5 open voice models On Hugging Face and ModelScope Speech synthesis, audio understanding, and speech recognition (listening, transcription, and speaking) 0.5-Bln params speech model supports voice cloning, seven languages, and control over speaking style Turn recordings into summaries, searchable lessons, multilingual narration, and reusable content https://github.com/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts-0.5B https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=54xriKZDP9Y

slides.title: AI News Perplexity open-sources SPACE, a sandbox for
slides.text: AI News Perplexity open-sources SPACE, a sandbox for AI agents Every Perplexity Computer task runs inside it , each task in its own Firecracker microVM Credentials and outbound traffic are controlled from outside, so an agent cannot read the secret it uses Red team: 9 models with root made 108 escape attempts and reached the host secret 0 times Egress was the weak point: 11 of 54 runs bypassed network policy before fixes Written in Rust, Apache 2.0 https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/15/perplexity-ai-open-sources-its-secure-ai-agent-sandbox-space/ US orders DeepSeek removed from federal civilian systems A DHS order requires civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and drop them from procurement Includes 3rd party products built on DeepSeek technology Reason - risk leaking sensitive data to China Agencies may ask for exceptions National security systems are handled separately. https://thenextweb.com/news/us-bars-deepseek-federal-agencies

slides.title: AI News Mistral Voxtral 3: speech models and
slides.text: AI News Mistral Voxtral 3: speech models and a voice agent SDK Three transcription models, one TTS model and a LiveKit-based agent SDK, all in public preview Covers 50+ languages, with speaker diarization and context biasing Small Transcribe 3 reaches 4.1% WER on FLEURS, against 16.0% for Whisper large-v3 Speech-to-text is priced at $0.0035 a minute Mini Transcribe 3 has 4B parameters. Mistral has not disclosed Small's size https://mistral.ai/news/voxtral-3/ Exa 3.0 search claims that it wins over Perplexity and Brave Exa is a US startup founded in 2021 by Will (William) Bryk and Jeff (Jeffrey) Wang, based in San Francisco, California https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/exa Exa 3.0 targets AI agents web retrieval for coding, finance, and deep research Exa claims wins over Perplexity, Brave, and Parallel across eight benchmarks https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/20/exa-3-0-search-api-lite/ Its own crawler and index track over 2 trillion URLs, including 1.27 Bln product listings and 211 million local businesses. Lite costs $4 per 1,000 requests; Auto costs $7 , offering developers a cost-versus-quality choice for AI search - https://exa.ai/blog/exa-3

slides.title: AI News Anthropic previews Claude Duet, a proactive
slides.text: AI News Anthropic previews Claude Duet, a proactive agent app Claude Duet runs in the cloud, on its own virtual machine with a browser, rather than on your phone or laptop Uses Opus 5.5 and sends you messages as needed Keeps working after you close the app, asks before sensitive actions Connects to 6,000+ apps such as Gmail and QuickBooks Summarizes updates from connected apps and handles tasks from scheduling to dashboards Research preview with a waitlist for US Pro and Max subscribers Competes with Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-duet Recursive Flint: Local Coding AI San Francisco-based Recursive , led by Richard Socher , released Flint Apache 2.0 open-weight coding model, 40B / 2.5B active params 23 GB four-bit weights fit a 48 GB Mac 125 tokens/sec on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro. 74.2% SWE-bench Verified; 54.9% Terminal-Bench 2.1 Recursive says its Eureka Machine automated research system helped develop nearly the entire stack, demonstrating faster, AI-assisted model development https://recursive.com https://recursive.com/updates/introducing-recursive-flint Anthropic - Claude Duet OpenAI - Dots Meta - Muse Google - Gemini Spark SpaceXAI / xAI - Grok Bot H Company - H Platform / Holo agent Mistral AI - Vibe (formerly Le Chat) Alibaba - Wukong Zhipu AI - AutoGLM / Rumination Alibaba - Qwen-Agent Manus - Manus OpenClaw Nous Research - Hermes Agent Abacus.AI - DeepAgent, Claw, Hermes

slides.title: AI News 1Password for Agents Lets agents log
slides.text: AI News 1Password for Agents Lets agents log in without seeing passwords The user approves each request 1Password fills the credentials into the site without seeing the paswd Gives agents account access while users keep control of their secrets https://1password.com/blog/1password-for-ai-agents Claude's text output now carries an invisible watermark Based on SynthID-Text , added to comply with the EU AI Act Works by nudging choices among near-equivalent words Adds no hidden characters or tokens The mark carries no information about the user https://www.oreilly.com/radar/the-latest-anthropic-claude-models-contain-ai-text-watermarks-what-does-this-mean-for-you
